text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: KV cache occupancy spike + continuous-batcher latency cliff detected (region: us-west-2). Auto-throttle triggered.

maria (oncall): seeing the alert, joining. latency dashboards show tail up ~3x in last 7m. possible paging + oversized batches?

sanjay (eng-runtime): looking at kv cache graphs now — working set jumped and eviction rate increased. there's a hotkey-like footprint across tenant mix. continuous-batcher queues are growing for long requests.

olivia (eng-sre): @maria please post the link to the dashboard? also are we seeing pack-shed events?

maria (oncall): dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv/cache?from=now-30m&to=now

maria (oncall): yes multiple pack-shed events. error logs show: 
```
2026-03-15T03:12:14Z [pack-shed] evicted=4326 reason=cache_pressure node=pool-12
2026-03-15T03:12:15Z [batcher] queue_len=128 mean_latency_ms=1200 p95=4520
```

keon (eng-ml): I can confirm a recent model rollout yesterday changed batching heuristics (auto-merge small requests into long-batched groups). suspect regression: mixed short/long request coalescing.

aaron (prod-sre): customer-facing? Claire, any active tickets?

claire (support): We have two high-priority customers reporting timeouts and slow responses (IDs C-824, C-999). Both ondedicated pools in us-west-2. CS updated them we’re investigating.

maria (oncall): initial mitigation idea: 1) temporarily disable cross-merge for continuous-batcher in us-west-2 2) reduce kv_cache prefetch window 3) throttle long requests >8s to a lower concurrency. Which one to do first?

sanjay (eng-runtime): quickest low-risk: flip batcher.cross_merge=false for us-west-2 config and roll to pool-12 (hot). Command: 
```
# patch via config service
curl -XPOST https://config.redwood/api/v1/patch -d '{"scope":"us-west-2","key":"batcher.cross_merge","value":false}' 
```

olivia (eng-sre): I'll apply the config to the pool and monitor. doing a canary to two nodes first.

olivia (eng-sre): canary applied to pool-12-node-03 and node-07. no regressions in logs so far. queue_len down from 128 -> 40 on canary nodes.

maria (oncall): ok proceed with region rollout. keep an eye on pack-shed counts.

olivia (eng-sre): rolling config across pool-12 now. ETA 3m.

incident-bot: Deployment started by olivia (eng-sre) — config/batcher.cross_merge -> false. Deployment id: dep-3321.

sanjay (eng-runtime): while rolling, also lowering kv_cache.prefetch_window from 5000 -> 1200 to reduce prefetch amplification. patch queued, will not require restart.

olivia (eng-sre): prefetch patch applied, observable: prefetch misses down 60%. eviction spikes reduced.

maria (oncall): customer impact update: Claire?

claire (support): Customers C-824 and C-999 report improved responses after ~10m. C-824 confirms partial recovery. Still watching for timeouts on heavy multimodal jobs.

keon (eng-ml): we should also add a short-term traffic policy: route >8s requests to dedicated slower-path pool to avoid blocking short requests. I can submit a routing rule.

aaron (prod-sre): good idea. but routing changes are higher-risk. Let's do it if the config roll doesn't fully stabilize in 15m.

maria (oncall): currently p95 across region dropped from 4.5s -> 1.2s after the batcher change. p99 down too. charts: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv/latency?from=now-15m

incident-bot: Note: automatic paging alarms were suppressed during config roll per safety policy.

olivia (eng-sre): pack-shed log tail after roll: 
```
2026-03-15T03:23:01Z [pack-shed] evicted=324 reason=cache_pressure node=pool-12
2026-03-15T03:24:11Z [batcher] queue_len=22 mean_latency_ms=210 p95=980
```

keon (eng-ml): this aligns with hypothesis: cross-merge allowed long tokseq requests to hold KV entries in cache, causing cache blowup. disabling it avoids long requests dominating the cache and batching slots.

maria (oncall): decision: keep cross_merge disabled for us-west-2 for now. create a patch to tune the batcher heuristics rather than disabling permanently. Assigning to sanjay & keon to propose a smarter policy.

sanjay (eng-runtime): will prepare a PR with a heuristic: limit cross-merge window to 200ms and avoid merging when request_length_tokens > 2048. Targets: reduce harmful coalescing while preserving small-request batching.

keon (eng-ml): will provide metric-driven thresholds from production traces. pulling 24h trace now.

claire (support): Customer comms: sending a proactive update — "we applied a mitigation and are monitoring; some customers may still see intermittent slowdowns".

aaron (prod-sre): logging note: create an alert for 'batcher.cross_merge_enabled && eviction_rate > 100/min' so we can auto-flag next time.

maria (oncall): handoff plan in 30m: if system stable (p95 < 2s for 30m, eviction rate back to baseline), we'll do an oncall handoff. Otherwise keep incident open and escalate.

incident-bot: Incident opened: KV-cache + continuous-batcher perf regression. Severity: P2. Incident channel: #incidents. Owner: maria (oncall). Incident ID: INC-20260315-78.

sanjay (eng-runtime): PR draft: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/merge-heuristics/pulls/456 — includes tests and a canary rollout plan.

keon (eng-ml): trace summary: heavy tail dominated by 3 tenants doing long-context generation loops. I'll reach out to those teams to suggest backoff and smaller chunking.

maria (oncall): outstanding action items: 1) sanjay/keon PR for heuristic 2) olivia keep region config disabled until PR validated 3) claire confirm customer comms sent 4) aaron add alert rule 5) follow-up postmortem if root cause confirmed.

claire (support): comms sent to affected customers. documenting timeline.

olivia (eng-sre): monitoring shows stable for 22 minutes. p95 ~1.1s. no new pack-shed.

maria (oncall): handing to next oncall in 30m if stable. If any regression pop, page the oncall channel.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled in 00:30:00.

maria (oncall): thanks all — great quick coordination. will file incident ticket and link to timeline + logs for postmortem.

sanjay (eng-runtime): noted. I'll include perf diffs and K/V access traces in the postmortem.

keon (eng-ml): will add model rollout footprint analysis and suggested batching config in the PM.

claire (support): closing customer tickets after final verify.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-78 status: mitigated; monitoring.
